title: 6. Keeping it up: dreams and the skill

sections.name: summary
sections.label: In short
sections.content: The audit is re-run on a cadence and after big changes; its failures become the work list for dreams and for whoever owns the repository.

sections.name: body
sections.label: How
sections.content: Dreams: srs-context's dream cycle can run the audit on its own memory and fix front-door and section regressions itself; for the programme and other corpora the exercise 'What may a dream change unattended in the programme?' decides how far a dream goes. The skill: the guide at engine.semanticops.com/structure.md teaches the same checks to anyone building a repository. The record: each re-run adds a dated scorecard here and moves issues between open and fixed (tags status:open and status:fixed).

sections.name: open
sections.label: Open
sections.content: Which thresholds are right is itself unknown: the audit's numbers were chosen, not measured. The manual checks (a read-through, a cold agent) are the test of the automated ones.
